title: Symmetric E-plane T-junction of WR-90, arms 20 mm, ports across x, x and y: S-parameters against field superposition
source: Field superposition in the junction square, three expansions (one per open side) matched to the LSE modes of the three guides (A. Sieverding, F. Arndt, IEEE Trans. MTT 40(2):353–362, 1992; J. Uher, J. Bornemann, U. Rosenberg, Waveguide Components for Antenna Feed Systems, Artech House 1993), emcraft-theory's `tee::e_plane` with 1500 modes per side (converged to about 1e-5), moved to the ports 20 mm out by e^{−jβ(l_i + l_j)}, l = 20 mm: `cargo run --release -p emcraft-theory --example tee_reference -- e 1500 20 8.5 10.5 12`
